title: Drew's privately funded vacuum chambers

tellings.quote: He's got one at his house.

plain: A man named Andrew Arjima, called Drew, is said to keep a vacuum chamber, a sealed tank with the air pumped out for testing equipment, at his own house, paid for privately. Charles Buhler, a guest the episode calls a NASA chief, says this to Michels from his own knowledge of Arjima's setup: "He's got one at his house."
